meta.title: Loqelo – Everything your place needs. Launching February 2027
meta.description: Loqelo connects people who need services for their home, garden or office with service providers who can do the job. Join the waitlist for the February 2027 launch.

hero.lead: Describe what your home, garden or office needs in your own words. Loqelo matches your request with service providers who can do the job, and you choose from the offers they send.
hero.note: Free to join. Unsubscribe any time.
hero.photoAlt: Two service providers cleaning large office windows
hero.phoneAlt: Loqelo mobile app showing offers from three service providers, sorted by best match

cats.title: From a dripping tap to moving house.
cats.lead: One place to ask for help with the services your home, garden and office need.
cats.ask: Want to know when Loqelo launches?

how.title: From one sentence to the right provider.
how.lead: Three steps, from describing what you need to choosing who does it.
how.s1d: Tell Loqelo what your home, garden or office needs, in your own words. Add photos if they help. Loqelo recognises the services in your request.
how.s1alt: Loqelo job form with a typed request and the recognised services: cleaning, window cleaning and car washing
how.s2d: Your request reaches service providers who offer those services in your area, so the right people can see it and respond.
how.s2alt: Loqelo provider view with a map of nearby requests matching their services
how.s3d: Offers arrive with price, timing and reviews side by side. Ask questions, compare, then pick the provider that suits you.
how.s3alt: Loqelo offers screen comparing five offers with a price range chart

video.title: See Loqelo in action.
video.lead: A short film about how a request becomes a finished job.
video.posterAlt: A man pressure-washing the wall of a modern house, with the caption: Need someone to wash the walls?

aud.custTitle: Need a hand? Describe it once.
aud.custLead: No more calling around. Write what you need, and offers come to you.
aud.cust1: Describe the job in your own words, by typing or speaking
aud.cust2: Receive offers from service providers who can do it
aud.cust3: Compare price, timing and reviews, then choose
aud.custAlt: Loqelo customer dashboard listing active jobs, with offers and latest activity
aud.provTitle: Need more jobs? Find them here.
aud.provLead: See requests from people nearby who need the services you offer.
aud.prov1: Browse requests that match your services and working area
aud.prov2: Send your offer with price, start date and a short note
aud.prov3: Track your bids and accepted jobs in one dashboard
aud.provAlt: Loqelo service provider dashboard with matching jobs on a map

launch.title: Loqelo opens in February 2027.
launch.lead: We're getting the platform ready for customers and service providers. Join the waitlist and we'll email you when Loqelo goes live.

form.title: Join the Loqelo waitlist.
form.lead: Leave your email and we'll let you know when Loqelo launches. It takes less than a minute.
form.point3: Unsubscribe with one click, any time
form.consent: I agree to receive emails from Loqelo about the launch and project updates. I can unsubscribe at any time. Read the Privacy Policy.
form.privacyNote: We only use your email to send Loqelo updates. We never sell it.
form.errEmailFormat: Enter a valid email address, like name@example.com.
form.errCountry: Choose a country from the list.
form.errConsent: Tick the box to agree to receive Loqelo emails. We need your consent to add you to the waitlist.
form.errNetwork: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
form.errServer: The waitlist didn't accept the request. Try again in a minute.
form.errRate: Too many attempts from this connection. Wait a few minutes and try again.
form.errSpam: The security check didn't pass. Reload the page and try again.
form.dupCustomer: This email is already on the customer waitlist. You don't need to do anything else.
form.dupProvider: This email is already on the service provider waitlist. You don't need to do anything else.
form.okCustomer: We'll keep you updated as Loqelo gets ready to launch.
form.okProviderTitle: Thanks for your interest in Loqelo!
form.okProvider: We'll keep you updated as we get closer to launch.
form.okConfirm: We've sent a confirmation link to your email. Open it to finish joining the waitlist.
form.crossToProvider: Also offer services? Join the provider waitlist
form.crossToCustomer: Also need services? Join the customer waitlist
form.preview: Demo mode: this form didn't send anything. On the live site, this step adds you to the waitlist.

final.title: Be there when Loqelo opens.
final.lead: Everything your place needs, from February 2027.

cookie.title: Cookies and analytics
cookie.text: With your permission, we use Google Analytics cookies to count visits and see which countries visitors come from. We never share what you type in our forms.
